purpose: Per-asset-class RWA delta (current vs Basel 3.1), output-floor binding analysis (72.5%), CET1 before/after, capital shortfall vs 12.5% total requirement. Six asset classes. Tornado chart. UK PRA PS1/26 go-live Jan 1, 2027.
